 Mr. Sushil Kumar Karwa ...Petiti
 Versus
 The State of Maharashtra And Anr. ...Respon

_ _ 
 Mr. Yashwardhan Tiwari a/w Ms. Deepa Panicker, learned Advocate for  the Petitioner.
 Mr. Vinit A. Kulkarni, learned A.P.P. for the State/Respondent.
 PSI Mr. Jaydeep N. Udage attached to Vile Parle Police Station, Mumbai  is present in the Court.
_  CORAM : ASHWIN D. BHOBE, J.
[VACATION COURT] DATE : 29th DECEMBER, 2025.

P.C. :
1. Heard Mr. Yashwardhan Tiwari, learned Advocate for the Petitioner.
2.

By the present Petition, the Petitioner is seeking quashing of the First Information Report bearing No. 512 of 2025 registered with Vile Parle Police Station, Mumbai, for the offences punishable under Sections 406 & 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

3. At the outset, Mr. Yashwardhan Tiwari, learned Advocate for the Petitioner submits that by inadvertence, the Complainant/Informant remained to be added to the present petition, he therefore seeks leave to add the 16-WP(ST)-26583-2025.doc Complainant/Informant as party Respondent No. 2.
4.
Mr. Vinit Kulkarni, learned APP for the State/Respondent does not object for grant o f t h e s a i d r e q u e s t .
L e a v e t o a m e n d t h e c a u s e - t i t t l e t o a d d t h e Complainant/Informant as Respondent No. 2 is granted.

Amendment to be carried Sushil Kumar Karwa vs State Of Maharashtra on 29 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33383395/
1 out forthwith.

sentences.text: 5. Mr. Yashwardhan Tiwari, learned Advocate for the Petitioner submits that perusal of the complaint would indicate that the Respondent No.2 has made an attempt to give a criminal flavour to a dispute which at the most can be a civil dispute.
He submits that the contents of the complaint do not disclose any offence warranting registration of an FIR.
He relies on the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Rikhab Birani and Another v/s. State of Uttar Pradesh and Another1.
